neighbours.label: the separators and items of a list of social benefits or insurance coverage (sickness, disability, pension, medical and dental)
fire: The program pays benefits for old age, sickness, disability and maternity.
Full-time staff receive health insurance, a pension, and paid vacation days.
The policy covers hospital stays, dental care and other unexpected expenses.
Members get free medical and dental treatment as well as sick pay.
The law requires employers to provide sick leave, severance pay and notice of termination.
Union workers are more likely to receive health benefits, a pension, and paid holidays.
The state fund covers unemployment, work injuries, disability and survivors' pensions.
Her contract includes life insurance, dental coverage and a retirement plan.
quiet: The shop sells apples, pears, plums and cherries at the weekend market.
Full-time staff receive a laptop, a desk, and a parking space.
The tour covers the old castle, the harbour and other famous sights.
Members get free coffee and pastries as well as a monthly newsletter.
The recipe requires flour, sugar, butter and a pinch of salt.
Union workers are more likely to wear helmets, gloves, and safety boots.
The festival features music, dancing, food stalls and fireworks.
Her suitcase includes a raincoat, walking shoes and a small umbrella.

notes: Top examples are commas and 'and' inside lists of welfare benefits, insurance and paid leave ('old age, sickness, disability', 'health benefits, a pension', 'medical and dental'). The + pole is health problems ('many physical health problems'). Near misses are lists of the same length in other domains.
